snippet.title: Blades of Fire - World Trailer [ESRB]
snippet.description:
Get ready to traverse across a beautiful but dangerous world in Blades of Fire.

From the scorched remains of Besacarr Hamlet to the frosty fortress of Winter's Wall, the journey ahead won't be easy. Are you ready to #ForgeYourLegend? 

Check out the Blades of Fire demo on May 15th.

Blades of Fire launches May 22nd on Epic, PS5 and Xbox X|S. ESRB rating: M
